t: You're on Cloth Fair, a short residential street just east of Smithfield, in the City of London's ward of Farringdon Within. In medieval times, merchants gathered here to buy and sell fabric during the Bartholomew Fair, and the street still carries that trade in its name. Among the people who lived here was Thomas Prattent, a publisher and printer who was active between about 1780 and 1800. He died in 1810. That is about all the record tells us, but it places a working printer on this old market street.
